nearest_source_surface_distance_m.interpretation: Slope points are mostly within about one dp of the source surface; block points include a recurring deeper tail of roughly 2.3 to 2.8 dp. Distance is evidence for triage, not a relaxed acceptance threshold.

mass_and_events.event_thresholds_and_reference_acceptanc: pending root-bound thresholds; not used to waive geometry failure

hypotheses.statement: The v2 materialization leaves a small amount of fluid available inside the closed block field at fill time and permits later block contact loss because STL boundary surfaces are drawn before a void fill but no explicit solid/void precursor is present in the Definition. This is the leading repair hypothesis for the block result.
evidence: The Definition uses fillbox mode=void after slope and block drawfilestl calls, with no explicit setmkvoid precursor.
A fluid endpoint is already inside a block at frame 0; its nearest transformed source surface distance is 0.000144085 m.
Fluid block endpoint counts persist and grow from 1 at frame 0 to 242 at frame 100 and remain 311 at frame 800.
Blocks contribute 1389 of 1435 sampled saved-chord crossings, and block inside-point tails reach 0.020864 m, about 2.8 dp.
The source block field is watertight and does not overlap the source slope, reducing source overlap and transform mistakes as explanations.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Materialize a fresh v3 case with an explicit closed-solid void/exclusion precursor for the transformed slope and blocks before fluid fill, then redraw the unchanged physical boundary faces. Compare frame-0 fluid endpoint occupancy and the full fluid block endpoint/chord gates with v2 under the same q, dp, motion, and transforms.
hypotheses.falsifier: If a root-reviewed explicit exclusion materialization still produces any frame-0 fluid endpoint inside slope/blocks or any full-window fluid block endpoint/chord crossing, H1 is falsified as a sufficient repair; do not reinterpret that failure as a threshold issue.

hypotheses.statement: A substantial portion of the slope count, and the shallow part of the block count, is a strict continuous-STL point-in-solid diagnostic sampling an effective finite-dp contact band around a discrete MkCells boundary. This can inflate endpoint counts near a wall even when the native boundary lattice is behaving as intended, but it cannot by itself waive the deeper block tail or saved-chord crossings.
evidence: The existing endpoint predicate uses exact transformed source-STL point-in-closed-mesh classification with a 1e-8 m tolerance, while the generated boundary is a dp-lattice MkCells materialization.
The generated static boundary has 968 slope triangles and 48,592 block triangles, whereas the source meshes have 8 and 1176 triangles respectively.
For frame 100 through 800, slope inside-point p90 distances are 0.004449 to 0.005681 m and maxima are 0.006787 to 0.008031 m, mostly about one dp.
The frame-0 fluid block point is only 0.000144085 m from the source surface, and a separate all-particle frame-0 count is dominated by boundary particles rather than fluid particles.
The fluid-only endpoint recount and the parent all-particle diagnostic differ in scope; mixing them would overstate fluid penetration.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: For the same decoded frames, report fluid-only and boundary-only scopes separately; bind a diagnostic signed-distance/contact-band comparison to generated MkCells; then require the repaired anchor to pass the exact fluid endpoint and saved-chord gates rather than accepting a distance-based waiver.
hypotheses.falsifier: If block endpoints remain at depths above one dp with independent full-window chord crossings after a successful void/exclusion materialization, H2 cannot explain the failure; the remaining failure is a native geometry/contact defect. If generated and source surfaces agree within a root-bound contact-band rule but exact fluid gates still fail, H2 is only a classification aid and provides no release credit.

recipe: Create the new v3 Definition and fresh adjacent assets under the proposed input identity.

Before fluid fill, materialize the transformed closed slope and block meshes as an explicit solid/void exclusion volume using the repository-supported GenCase STL void/autofill mechanism selected by root review.

Redraw the same physical slope and block faces with their existing boundary markers and transforms after the exclusion precursor; preserve source geometry, q=0.5 motion, dp, domain, gauges, and output cadence.

If the native mechanism cannot represent the closed exclusion robustly, root review may select a separately named one-dp outward shell asset. That shell must have a new hash and its physical deviation must be recorded; it must not alter the v2 assets in place.
Do not change endpoint tolerances, event thresholds, the matrix denominator, or the qualification contract to make the observed v2 counts pass.
minimal_repair_candidate.why_minimal: It changes only the order/materialization of the closed geometry exclusion while preserving the F5 physical input and observation contract. It directly tests H1 and leaves H2 measurable.
minimal_repair_candidate.implementation_authority: The literal XML syntax and any shell construction require root review before any file is written or any preflight is run.

required_review: Choose and bind the literal GenCase void/exclusion materialization syntax or reject H1.
Approve the new input/output identity and hash-closure procedure.
Authorize at most one fresh CPU/native preflight; a later solver anchor requires a separate root review.
Keep the denominator at 15 rows, qualification_claim none, matrix_credit 0, and same-input retry forbidden until every full-window geometry gate passes.

limitations: The current scientific report samples 9 of 801 frames and stride-32 surface particles; it cannot establish a full-window zero-crossing result.
The source-STL predicate is a diagnostic geometry oracle and does not by itself encode DualSPHysics finite-particle contact semantics.
The generated runtime-domain numeric envelope is not explicit in the v2 Definition; the 103552 sampled envelope-outside count remains a separate pending contract issue.
Mass change is zero in sampled frames, but the F5 contract does not bind a numeric full-window mass threshold.
No hypothesis here authorizes threshold relaxation, event reinterpretation, or qualification credit.
